token.first_name.note: the composer's token menu: a contact field

token.unsubscribe_url.note: the composer's token menu: links ReputeCast fills in per recipient at send time

fallback.first_name.note: goes into the email for its readers when a contact has no first name: Hi {{ first_name | default: "there" }}. One word, lower case, no punctuation

problem.line.note: a personalization tag that doesn't parse; message is the template parser's own explanation, in English

problem.loopLimit.message: Loops are limited to {max} items; ({from}..{to}) has {count}.
problem.loopLimit.note: a for loop over a range of numbers that is too long; ({from}..{to}) is the range as written in the template
